name: Carestino
description: Uruguayan baby products store selling strollers, car seats, cribs, high chairs, baby carriers, bags, bath, safety and feeding items online. Delivers nationwide, with free shipping above a stated order amount.
description_es: Tienda uruguaya de artículos para bebé con cochecitos, butacas, cunas, sillas, porteo, bolsos, baño, seguridad y alimentación en línea. Envía a todo el país, con envío gratis sobre un monto de compra indicado.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping to the whole country on orders over 1,200 pesos; interior 2 to 5 business days, Montevideo up to 2 business days, per the store's shipping page

shopping_notes: Product search is verified by the probe. The shipping page links a store locator but does not describe order pickup.

sources.supports: Shipping: nationwide, free over 1,200 pesos, delivery times by zone
